title: Survey of Open-Source Double Pendulum Simulators

implementations.name: dassencio/double-pendulum
implementations.energy_validation: Yes - tracks maximum energy change to detect unstable simulations
implementations.notes: Clean, well-documented. Companion theory pages at dassencio.org/33 and dassencio.org/46.

implementations.name: josmarcristello/Double-Pendulum-Simulation
implementations.notes: MIT License. Includes detailed technical/explained report.

implementations.name: ellawang44/double_pendulum_sim
implementations.notes: PHYS3001 project. Includes Lyapunov exponent computation for varying initial conditions and parameters. Multiple input groups: parameters, numerical integration, single/multiple Lyapunov exponents, plots.

implementations.name: shinben0327/Double-Pendulum-Lyapunov
implementations.visualization: Heatmaps of average max Lyapunov exponent
implementations.notes: Focused on Lyapunov exponent computation. Varies masses 0.5-30 kg.

best_practices_summary: Use 4th-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) as primary integrator for accuracy
Accept parameters (m1, m2, L1, L2, g) as function arguments, not hardcoded
Track energy conservation as a validation metric throughout simulation
Store state as [theta1, omega1, theta2, omega2] vector for clean ODE interface
Use both Lagrangian (simpler) and Hamiltonian (needed for symplectic methods) formulations
Implement from-scratch RK4 for educational value; use scipy for validation
Save full trajectory data for post-processing analysis
